description: Index of all relevant features, classes, entities, components, and contracts defined in the GPWCF Primary Architecture Stage/Step Level documents, Prefect Adoption & Integration Architecture, and Architecture Closure Design documents. Links are relative to this index file location.

records.name: Step Callable
records.description: Wave 2 detailed design (artifact 1) defining the stable Stage-facing callable boundary of a Step, including explicit invocation identity and parent Stage correlation, while preserving the Step Aggregate as the owner of its internal Step Composition and the sole public boundary for Step execution and StepExecutionResult.

records.name: Step Entity / Aggregate Root
records.description: A Stage-composable processing and orchestration component that exposes a stable callable contract to its owning Stage while internally coordinating its specialized Step Processing Units and applicable supporting units. Architectural level: stage-step, owning level: Stage.

records.name: Step[TInput,TOutput]
records.description: Generic Step contract with type parameters TInput (input type accepted from owning Stage) and TOutput (output artifact type exposed to owning Stage). No common concrete types imposed across Steps.

records.name: Step Logical Operation - execute
records.description: Signature execute(input: TInput) -> StepExecutionResult[TOutput]. The Stage-facing public callable; input supplied by owning Stage, output is the Step-level structured aggregate result.

records.name: StepInvocation
records.description: Typed invocation envelope carrying the input and required identity/correlation context (Step identity, Step invocation identity, owning Stage identity, parent Stage invocation identity, optional pipeline identity, execution context).

records.name: Step Public Callable Boundary
records.description: Stage-facing facade boundary that exposes Step capability without exposing internal component topology. Stage sees only public input/output contract and Step-level result; Stage does not invoke SPUs or supporting units directly.

records.name: Step Composition
records.description: The Step-owned internal composition boundary responsible for coordinating pluggable processing and supporting components required by one concrete Step. Architectural level: stage-step, owning level: Step. Not a separately allocated runtime object or universal engine.

records.name: StepComposition Internal Orchestration
records.description: Owns internal component composition and Step-specific orchestration decisions; selects and coordinates SPUs and supporting-unit instances; preserves invocation-scoped facts/results/exceptions/custody; applies Step-specific flow decisions.

records.name: Step Execution Result
records.description: Wave 2 detailed design (artifact 2) defining the Step-level structured result returned to Stage, preserving the processing artifact and independently optional Step-specialized aggregates while adding explicit invocation provenance and type-safe optional-result contribution boundary.

records.name: StepExecutionResult[TOutput]
records.description: Structured result of one Step invocation returned to its owning Stage. Carries the Step-level processing artifact and independently optional Step-specialized validation, error, and error-handling aggregates.

records.name: Optional Result Contributions
records.description: Wave 2 detailed design (artifact 3) defining a closed, typed, independently optional contribution model for the Step-level validation, error, and error-handling aggregates, preserving specialized result ownership.

records.name: OptionalResultContributions Aggregate
records.description: Closed aggregate grouping the three baseline optional Step-level result categories (validatorResult, errorResult, errorHandlerResult) for transport through the Step result without redefining their meaning.

records.name: OptionalResultSlot
records.description: Discriminated presence model where each contribution slot is independently present or absent. Absent and Present(None) are distinct; absence alone is not a universal status.

records.name: Step Lifecycle - RetainForReuse
records.description: Step lifecycle disposition requesting continued availability for reuse. Complete only when reuse/reset/readiness/isolation conditions are satisfied; admission closure is staged during settlement/reset.

records.name: Step Lifecycle - TerminalRetirement
records.description: Step lifecycle disposition requesting terminal release. Complete only when admission is closed, all accepted invocations and obligations are settled, and required internal release is confirmed.

records.name: Step Admission Boundary
records.description: Linearizable ordering at the Step public boundary for admission of execute invocations and closure for RetainForReuse or TerminalRetirement. Invocations accepted before closure belong to the retirement settlement set.

records.name: Prefect Adoption and Integration Architecture
records.description: Establishes Prefect 3.9.2 as GPWCF's adopted external workflow runtime (ADR-GPWCF-PREFECT-001), defining integration boundary, responsibility boundaries, mapping of 13 reference-consumer stages, implementation sequence, and traceable acceptance plan.

records.name: ADR-GPWCF-PREFECT-001
records.description: Accepted decision to adopt Prefect 3 as the external workflow runtime. Uses Prefect-native Flows/Subflows and Tasks as execution constructs while preserving GPWCF-owned component contracts, semantic composition, typed outcomes, identity domains, artifact custody, and specialized relationship rules.

records.name: Prefect Native Hierarchy Topology
records.description: GPWCF-to-Prefect boundary mapping: Pipeline Root -> Native Flow, Stage -> Stage Parent Flow, Step -> Step Subflow, SPU -> Native Task. Uses invoke_stage and invoke_step dispatch Tasks as invocation mechanisms.

records.name: Prefect Dispatch Tasks
records.description: Narrow Prefect Task dispatch wrappers (invoke_stage, invoke_step) used to invoke native child Flow objects while preserving Prefect parent_task_run_id relationships. Carry no GPWCF business or composition semantics.

records.name: Domain Identity versus Prefect Operational Identity
records.description: GPWCF domain identities (Pipeline, Stage, Step, SPU, invocation) remain separate from Prefect Flow Run IDs and Task Run IDs. Prefect State is operational execution evidence, not a domain result.

records.name: PHASE-00 Contract Inventory
records.description: Baseline-frozen inventory of generic Stage/Step/SPU/result contracts and versions, environment baseline (CPython 3.15.1 / Prefect 3.9.2), and PHASE-00 disposition identifying open gaps for subsequent phases.

records.name: PHASE-01 Acceptance Results
records.description: Native hierarchy acceptance results qualifying Pipeline Root Flow, Stage Parent Flows, Step Subflows, SPU Tasks, and identity correlation. Fixture-only qualification; production GPWCF binding out of scope.

records.name: PHASE-02 Acceptance Results
records.description: Deployment-backed Stage invocation acceptance results qualifying same-host two-Process-Worker concurrent sibling Stage Flow execution, native identity correlation, indirect parent linkage, and Stage result retrieval.

records.name: Contract Classification and Allocation
records.description: PHASE-03 evidence-based classification and logical module allocation of existing GPWCF architecture artifacts and contracts before defining module boundaries, dependency architecture, or filesystem changes.

records.name: Dependency and Public API Architecture
records.description: PHASE-03 defining dependency ownership and direction, installation profiles, and Core vs Prefect Integration Public APIs. DEP-002: Prefect is opt-in dependency of Prefect Integration package, never Core.

records.name: Filesystem Architecture
records.description: PHASE-03 accepted filesystem/package ownership architecture materializing approved package boundaries and package markers only; directories allocated by cohesive ownership and dependency boundary.

records.name: Framework Module Boundary Model
records.description: PHASE-03 logical module and dependency-boundary baseline retaining Entity/Aggregate ownership: Stage, Step, SPU as distinct Entities; composition owned by Aggregate; Core owns domain contracts, Prefect owns execution mechanisms.

records.name: Core Public API vs Prefect Integration Public API
records.description: Separable public API surfaces; Core must remain usable with Prefect absent. No Prefect types leak into Core API. Public API is an explicit curated stable boundary under public_api.

records.name: Architectural Goals
records.description: Defines the target architecture: Prefect 3.9.2 native execution, GPWCF Public API (Core + Prefect), Stage/Step/SPU Entities, Supporting Patterns, and four non-violable conditions (Functional Completeness, Hierarchical Completeness, Dependency Integrity, Runtime Independence).

records.name: Functional Completeness Condition
records.description: Every function must have a clear contract, implementation, result, and defined lifecycle responsibility.

records.name: Hierarchical Completeness Condition
records.description: Each level participates in hierarchical nesting within its own scope without requiring a custom workflow engine inside GPWCF.

records.name: Dependency Integrity Condition
records.description: No reverse or circular dependencies between components.

records.name: Runtime Independence Condition
records.description: Core remains usable without requiring Prefect installation, while allowing Prefect integration when necessary.

records.name: Stage Callable Contract (G-01 / F-08)
records.description: Unified contract defining how a Stage receives invocation, returns result, and integrates with parent workflow. StageAggregate implementing a callable contract independent of Prefect; StageCallableContract has no awareness of Flow, Deployment, or FlowRun.

records.name: Stage Flow Result Strategy (G-02 / F-06)
records.description: Generic StageResult contract with specialized payload (StageResult[TStagePayload]) consisting of generic envelope (Stage identity, invocation identity, completion, outcome classification, correlation, settlement, diagnostics) plus consumer-specialized payload.

records.name: Pipeline Root Contract (G-03)
records.description: Pipeline Invocation Contract without a Root Entity (Option C): defines Pipeline Invocation Identity, Stage Invocation Requests, Shared Pipeline Context, Stage Result Collection, Overall Pipeline Settlement, Correlation Information. Root Flow remains consumer-owned and executed by Prefect.

records.name: Generic Diagnostics Contract (G-04)
records.description: Constrained Generic Diagnostics Contract followed by decoupling of Generator Error Model; Dependency Closure Analysis identifies which contracts require diagnostics, specialized error handling, or generator-specific error semantics.

records.name: StepExecutionResult Optional Result Slots (G-05 / F-05)
records.description: Typed extension slots combined with typed result contributions. StepExecutionResult[TCoreResult, TOptionalContributions] structure; Core Result mandatory, optional results added via typed contributions with clear identities and types.

records.name: Single Step Publication (G-06)
records.description: Publication/recovery policy remains a concrete consumer specialization; no generic transaction manager or universal publication policy is introduced.

records.name: Production Prefect Binding (G-07)
records.description: Fixture qualification is not production binding evidence; real GPWCF contract binding and failure/cancellation/recovery qualification remain required before production Prefect binding.

records.name: F-01 Independence of StepExecutionResult from Step Aggregate
records.description: StepExecutionResult remains logically independent module within the Step package (Option B); contract defines Step identity, invocation identity, completion status, SPU results, supporting unit results, reconciliation information, and failure/uncertainty details without Prefect-specific states.

records.name: F-02 Conditional Step Error Model
records.description: Three independent concepts: Error Identity/Description, Failure Semantics, Execution Outcome. Minimal core derived from Generic Diagnostics; Error Handling remains optional Supporting Pattern under core/supporting_patterns/error_handling/.

records.name: F-03 Architectural Guidance
records.description: Documentation + Conformance Rules (Option B); programmatically verifiable rules enforceable through architecture tests (e.g., Stage not permitted to call SPU directly, Core not permitted to import Prefect, SPU not permitted to import Step Composition).

records.name: F-04 Consumer Boundary
records.description: Consumer treated as independent project relying on Public API (Option C); Consumer Integration Contract defines architectural boundary without creating consumer runtime or generator package within GPWCF.

records.name: F-05 Correcting Dependency Direction between SPU and Step
records.description: Option 4: both interact via independent contracts with Step retaining coordination responsibility. Step Composition selects SPUs; SPU has no reverse package dependency on Step; no Universal Executable Unit introduced.

records.name: F-07 Packaging Architecture
records.description: Option A: Single Distribution with Optional Prefect Extra (gpwcf Core + optional prefect extra). Core installs without Prefect; installing Core does not trigger indirect Prefect installation. One GPWCF distribution for initial release.

records.name: F-09 Public API Tests
records.description: Public API Conformance Suite demonstrating Public API functions as stable interface; tests/core/, tests/public_api/core/, tests/public_api/integrations/prefect/, tests/integrations/prefect/, tests/architecture/ structure.

records.name: F-10 Shared Contracts
records.description: Create shared contracts only when clear need arises for contract independent of any specific entity (Option C). Acceptance criteria: more than one actual consumer, meaning independent of entity, no consumer implementation dependency, no circular dependency, clear ownership.

records.name: PHASE-03 Suggested ADRs and Remaining Gates
records.description: Accepted PHASE-03 dispositions for Step Result, Conditional Step Error Model, Architectural Guidance, Consumer, SPU/Step Dependency, Stage Result, Packaging, Stage Callable, Public API Tests, Shared Contracts, Pipeline Root, Optional Result Slots, Single Step Publication, Prefect Binding.

records.name: Stage Composition Owns Step Membership
records.description: Stage Composition coordinates Step public contracts only; Step Composition coordinates SPUs and selected Supporting Units. Composition is an aggregate responsibility owned by the Entity/Aggregate whose internal elements it coordinates.

records.name: SPU/Step Dependency Direction
records.description: Step Composition to SPU contract only; SPU has no reverse package dependency on Step. SPU package is independently callable processing Entity, not a Step subfolder.

records.name: PHASE-03 Disposition and Remaining Gates
records.description: PHASE-03 disposition (2026-11-09) for G-01 through G-07; remaining gates include Stage callable contract/signature, Stage-specific Flow Result contract, StepExecutionResult optional result-slot typing, generic error vocabulary, concrete publication/recovery specialization, production Prefect binding, minimal Prefect lock, build backend/pinning.

records.name: GPWCF Distribution Shape
records.description: One GPWCF distribution with dependency-free Core base and optional Prefect extra. Core installs and imports without Prefect; optional extra supplies Prefect Integration runtime. prefect==3.9.2 remains the direct Integration requirement.

records.name: Reference Consumer (SMRB.PayloadDescriptionGenerator)
records.description: Reference consumer for target-specific integration design and end-to-end acceptance; 13 specified stages (STG-01 through STG-13). Stage Model objectives and execution_steps are not presumed to be GPWCF Steps or SPUs.
